items.title: Goldman Sachs to acquire Neos for up to $2.25b cash and stock
items.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs Group Inc. will pay up to $2.25 billion to acquire Neos Investments, expanding its presence in the actively managed exchange-traded fund market, according to a Bloomberg report early Wednesday.

Neos, which provides ETFs on systematic options-based income, managed $30 billion in assets across ‌19 funds ⁠as of June 30.
